finding: The scope of a story is now built in two places that must stay equal. merge-story builds the premerge-check arguments at packages/factory/scripts/dispatch:2326-2347 from the declared outputs, backlog/<id>.md, the spec-feedback report, HOOK_REWRITTEN_INDEX, and the owned review and finding files. _story_scope_violation builds the same list again at lines 404-433, and _in_declared_scope repeats the prefix and glob rule of premerge-check. Today the two lists match, so escalate refuses exactly the paths that premerge-check would refuse. A later change that adds a path to one list only makes escalate and merge-story disagree, and nothing would fail. The smallest fix is one helper in dispatch, for example _story_scope(project_root, entry, target) returning the list of (flag, path) pairs, which merge-story turns into --scope and --scope-glob arguments and _story_scope_violation matches against.
why_this_severity: Both lists hold the same five parts today, and RL-06-IT-05 checks that escalate grants once the diff is back inside the scope (no to fails_purpose). A later change to the scope rule must be made twice, and a missed copy makes escalate refuse a story that merge-story accepts, or the other way round.
